bibliographic.title: Mimeografika
bibliographic.author: amberMechanic
bibliographic.description:
You are Eloise Genium, a robot just arrived on Twin Earth. You touch down in its capital: Luxopolis. Your arch-enemy, Artemis, is set to arrive here soon, bringing chaos and destruction in her wake.

The population of the bustling city doesn't know what's about to hit them.

Mimeografika is a simple sci-fi Twine game illustrated in one bit art. Explore a strange alien city in an unlikely future. Scavenger-hunt your way through and face off against your evil twin in a final climactic showdown.
